title: Weitere Logovarianten
slide_intent: Define exceptional identity forms so practical production needs do not become unrestricted variation.
strategic_value: A limited white-interior option can preserve DB recognition when the standard mark cannot be produced.
demonstration: Two columns distinguish the white-interior red logo from the soundlogo and explain their roles.
practical_value: Use the white-interior version only for the stated construction or production limitation; consult sound guidance for audio endings.
